# Wits University

> Wits University is a leading South African research institution in Johannesburg offering comprehensive academic programmes, innovative research opportunities, and vibrant campus life.

Wits University serves as a hub for higher education and research excellence across multiple disciplines including health sciences, law, and innovation. The institution supports students, staff, and alumni through integrated digital platforms and world-class facilities.
